items.name: BuildError
items.summary: An error that occurs when construction of a `Regex` fails.

methods.name: pattern
methods.summary: If it is known which pattern ID caused this build error to occur, then this method returns it.

methods.name: size_limit
methods.summary: If this error occurred because the regex exceeded the configured size limit before being built, then this returns the configured size limit.

methods.name: syntax_error
methods.summary: If this error corresponds to a syntax error, then a reference to it is returned by this method.
